technology_name: AN AUTOMONOUS DRONE-BASED INTELLIGENT SYSTEM FOR COCONUT HARVESTING AND METHOD THEREOF
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Manual harvesting of high-altitude coconut palms involves severe tree-fall injury risks, exhibits low operational speed, and encounters acute labor shortages.
description: An autonomous aerial harvesting system comprising an unmanned drone hardware base integrated with artificial intelligence (AI) computer vision tracking scripts and an active laser cutting attachment to execute automated bunch detachment.
applications: Automated plantation harvesting networks, precision agricultural drone fleets, commercial orchard management grids, and autonomous farming hardware platforms.
